ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity (white) pixels dominate >90% of the visible ventral surface, with high-contrast low-intensity (black) pixels localized to the peripheral boundary of the trailing edge and lobe tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary contiguous high-intensity white field across both lobes. Distinct low-intensity black perimeter banding. One isolated dark pixel cluster (focal spot) located in the upper-mid region of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible V-shaped central depression; moderately deep incision separating the lobes with an acute interior angle.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration along the trailing edge with variable pixel amplitude. Notable irregularity and larger indentation at the distal terminus of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the primary lobe surface transitioning to a slight posterior sweep at the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small dark pixel clusters concentrated along the trailing edge, particularly dense near the right tip, indicating peripheral colonization points.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Geometric irregularity/loss of material at the far right lobe tip creating a jagged, non-uniform terminal edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Single isolated dark focal spot positioned against the high-intensity white background in the upper-left quadrant of the fluke area.
